Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single thread: 

- Goal: show a 45–60m demo focused on integration patterns (SSO, data routing) + security deep dive for Samir and procurement checklist for Priya.
- Prep ask: if you can share Samir's security requirements or the RFI PDF ahead of the demo that would help us tailor the runbook.
- Timing: two proposed demo windows below (PDT):
  • Tue 19 May, 10:00–11:00
  • Wed 20 May, 15:00–16:00

Please confirm which slot works and any additional stakeholders we should include. I cc'd Marissa to ensure we can offer a second engineer if you want a deeper platform walkthrough.

Attachments: I left a short demo-prep checklist in the shared folder (link in my next email).

Thanks,
Karthik

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers from our side: 

- Samir (cc'd) is our security lead and will attend the security portion. He asked for your SOC 2 and any network/VPC guidance you have pre-demo.
- Priya (procurement) will own contract timing; our target is to complete procurement review within 3 weeks of the demo if the pilot looks good.
- Both slots generally work; leaning toward Tue 19 May 10am PDT but want to confirm internally.

Perfect — thanks for the uploads, Alex. Looping in a few folks on our side so we have the right coverage for the session: Mina (security), Olga (platform engineering) and Rishi (sales ops / procurement).

Proposed plan before the demo:
- I will send a calendar invite for Tue 19 May, 10:00–11:00 PDT as a hold. If Priya confirms a different slot I will update.
- Mina: I already shared a short SOC 2 summary and network guidance link; Mina, can you post the SOC 2 redacted cert and a one-page network/VPC checklist to the shared folder by EOD tomorrow?
- Olga: please be ready to walk through SSO options (SAML / OIDC), and verify whether the customer can use their IdP with our hosted/private options.
- Rishi: once Priya confirms the slot I’ll circulate a procurement checklist and the standard pilot agreement template.

Action items for Alex / Priya:
1) Confirm whether Tue 19 May 10:00 PDT is good for you — if not, we’ll move to Wed 20 May 15:00 PDT.
2) Samir — if you have any high-priority RFI items beyond the attached doc, drop them here.

I attached a short demo agenda and prep note as well (demo-prep.pdf).

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.
Karthik
